claims: Justin Bieber and Hailey Bieber primarily reside in a $25.8 million mansion in Beverly Park, Los Angeles, California.
Beverly Park is a guard-gated community in Los Angeles, California.
Justin Bieber and Hailey Bieber purchased an 11,145-square-foot modern farmhouse-style home in Beverly Park in 2020.

The Madison Club is a gated community in the Coachella Valley.
Justin Bieber and Hailey Bieber use their La Quinta home as a desert retreat.
Justin Bieber and Hailey Bieber own a 101-acre lakefront estate in Puslinch, Ontario.
Justin Bieber and Hailey Bieber purchased their Puslinch estate for $5 million in 2018.
Their Puslinch estate served as Justin Bieber and Hailey Bieber's primary residence during the COVID-19 pandemic.
Reports from 2025 indicate Justin Bieber and Hailey Bieber own a private $7 million lakeside home near Gozzer Ranch in Coeur d'Alene, Idaho.
